reports.title: Optimism SafetyChecker (ConsenSys Diligence)
reports.description: Two-person-week differential fuzzing engagement comparing OVM_SafetyChecker.isBytecodeSafe against a custom Go reference implementation, with an informal specification of safe OVM bytecode and forward-looking recommendations. No divergences or vulnerability findings were reported.

versions.coverage: Differential fuzzing of isBytecodeSafe only (100% code coverage reported); not a general security review of the file.

reports.title: Optimism Bridge Audit (OpenZeppelin, May 2022)
reports.description: OpenZeppelin audit of the new Bedrock L1/L2 bridge and messaging contracts (OptimismPortal, L2OutputOracle, cross-domain messengers, standard bridges, L2ToL1MessagePasser, mintable tokens) in the optimistic-specs repository, reviewed across three successive commits during a rewrite. Offchain components and L2 nodes were assumed to work as documented.

versions.coverage: All production contracts reviewed for the majority of the audit. Findings are reported against the later commits; issues no longer relevant after the rewrite were disregarded.

reports.title: Optimism: Rollup Node and Execution Engine - Fix Review
reports.description: Trail of Bits fix review of the twelve findings from its April 2022 audit of the Bedrock rollup node (optimistic-specs, Go and Solidity) and the reference execution engine (reference-optimistic-geth). Solidity findings target the L1 deposit/withdrawal contracts and the L1Block predeploy; the remaining findings target Go code and specifications.

versions.coverage: Original audit target (whole repository, Golang and Solidity); High findings located in Solidity: TOB-OPT-1 (WithdrawalsRelay), TOB-OPT-3 (DepositFeed), TOB-OPT-6 (L1Block). TOB-OPT-5 (High) is in the Go node only.
Head of pull request 378 fixing TOB-OPT-1 (reentrancy in WithdrawalsRelay).
Head of pull request 383 fixing TOB-OPT-3 (DepositFeed gasLimit type). TOB-OPT-6 was resolved in op-node code (pull request 386) without contract changes.
